scenes.text: This is the round that still ends on paper. A clipboard, a shift, and numbers retyped back at the office, hours after the reading was taken.
Plant, pipeline, refinery. Alarm floods, relief valves past their test date, and inspection findings that nobody can find at two in the morning.
IntegrityWatch Field runs on the tablet. No server, no cloud, and no signal required before an operator can make a decision.
Import the round as a CSV. Forty eight readings, mapped, validated and committed on the device. Zero rows skipped, and the evidence stays with the shift.
Register the equipment against ISO 14224, set the risk band, and the inspection interval follows. Overdue relief valves surface on their own.
Then generate the dossier on the same tablet, ready to print, sign and hand over without waiting for the network to come back.
Field data, field decisions, no signal required.
